name: SMTP
summary: Sends the platform's email through an SMTP server the deployment chooses, over STARTTLS.

capabilities.trigger_rule: A message the outbox holds for sending: one a person or a rule of the platform asked for.

address.title: Server
address.description: The SMTP server's host and port, such as smtp.example.com:587; it must offer STARTTLS.

domain.title: Message-ID domain
domain.description: The domain in each message's Message-ID; the platform sender's when empty.

dns_records.title: DNS records
dns_records.description: The records each sending domain needs for this provider, as its dashboard lists them; the nightly domain check looks for each one.

health_check: Counts the server's refusals and broken connections in recent sends; the server cannot be asked what became of a message.
test_action: Sends one test message to the signed-in person's own verified address and reports whether the server took it.
local_substitute: Mailpit in the local stack (localhost:1025, without TLS), and an SMTP fake in tests.
